ODE Solutions (SymPy Verified)

# Equation Solution Type
1 x(dy/dx) + y = 0 y(x) = C1/x 1st Order
2 dy/dx = e^x y(x) = C1 + e^x 1st Order
3 d²y/dx² + y = 0 y(x) = C1·sin(x) + C2·cos(x) 2nd Order
4 dy/dx - cos(x) = 0 y(x) = C1 + sin(x) 1st Order
5 y' + 5y = 0 y(x) = C1·e^(-5x) 1st Order
6 d²y/dx² = cos(3x) + sin(3x) y(x) = C1 + C2·x - sin(3x)/9 - cos(3x)/9 2nd Order
7 y''' + 2y'' + y' = 0 y(x) = C1 + (C2 + C3·x)·e^(-x) 3rd Order
